title: Induced current direction
description: Essential: Student must correctly state that induced current flows from b to a (or equivalent) using appropriate reasoning.

title: Motional EMF calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute E = BLv = 0.05 V with proper units.

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Important: Student must apply Ohm's law to find total current I = E/(R+r) = 0.025 A.

title: External force magnitude
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate F = BIL = 6.25×10⁻³ N as the external force magnitude.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student must recognize that constant velocity implies external force equals magnetic force on the rod.

title: Right-hand rule application
description: Optional: Student explicitly applies right-hand rule(s) to determine current direction or force direction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis or includes correct units in all intermediate steps.

title: Incorrect EMF formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses wrong formula for motional EMF (e.g., missing v, L, or B).

title: Resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Student neglects internal resistance r when calculating circuit current.

title: Velocity misconception
description: Pitfall: Student assumes acceleration or uses force formulas inappropriate for constant velocity.
